question: Should OpenClaw approve bundled modular dashboard log-tail and command-output widgets now, and what data-source, redaction, scope, retention, and export boundaries must they follow?
rationale: The feature is plausible and aligned with operator ergonomics, but it exposes operational logs and command output in a new always-available dashboard surface and depends on unmerged dashboard/binding contracts.

options.title: Stage After Substrate Review
options.body: Keep this issue open, settle the dashboard substrate and binding model first, then implement read-only widgets against approved `logs.tail` and command-output contracts.

options.title: Approve A Narrow Log Widget First
options.body: Allow a smaller follow-up that only tails the existing gateway log source and explicitly excludes command output or command execution until a separate design lands.

options.title: Defer Or Externalize
options.body: Leave the request as roadmap context or move optional widget experimentation outside bundled OpenClaw until maintainers sponsor this dashboard surface.

recommendation.title: Stage After Substrate Review
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, settle the dashboard substrate and binding model first, then implement read-only widgets against approved `logs.tail` and command-output contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest current-main history on the Control UI plugin-tab and log-tail surfaces that constrain this decision.
